feature: Detach Audio keeps the sound's mix
summary: Taking a recording's sound off its picture now brings its volume, fades, gain, noise cleaning and audio effects with it. Before, the detached sound started over as if nobody had touched it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording with the timeline showing.

try.do: Right-click the recording on V1 and choose Audio > Clean Noise.
Pick the recording and set its Audio Fades In to 1.0s and its volume down a little in the panel.
Right-click its sound on the Audio track and choose Detach Audio (or press ⌃⇧D).
Right-click the detached sound: it offers Remove Noise Cleaning, and its panel shows Clean noise ticked.
Check its Fades and Volume in the panel: the same values you set before detaching.
Press ⌘Z: the sound is linked again, with its cleaning, fade and volume as they were.

evaluate: After Detach Audio, does the sound sound exactly the same as it did while linked?
Does the fade line drawn on the detached sound's bar sit where it was on the linked one?
After undo, is anything about the linked sound different from before?
rough: No mock covers this: it is a fix to keep work you already did, with no new surface.
The silent picture keeps no copy of the mix once detached; there is no reattach command today, so nothing reads it back.
